wordProblems.q: A shop packs 42 eggs into boxes of 7 eggs. How many boxes does the shop fill?
James buys 7 pencils for $6 each. James pays with $50. How many dollars of change does James get?
4 friends share the cost of a $60 game equally. How many dollars does each friend pay?
Zoe watches a cartoon for 21 minutes and then plays outside for 44 minutes. How many minutes did Zoe spend in all?
Sam needs 90 minutes to finish a puzzle. Sam has already worked for 55 minutes. How many more minutes does Sam need?
Ava buys 6 packs with 4 stickers in each pack, then shares all the stickers equally with 2 friends, so 3 children share them. How many stickers does each child get?
A garden is 11 metres long and 7 metres wide. How many square metres is the garden?
Ethan earns $9 each week for 4 weeks. Ethan buys a ball for $29. How many dollars does Ethan have left?
Leo puts 42 marbles into bags of 6 marbles each. Leo finds 5 more marbles. How many marbles does Leo have in all?
Each bus holds 32 children. 2 buses are full, and 15 more children walk. How many children are going on the trip?
A recipe needs 4 eggs for one cake. A baker makes 5 cakes and uses 7 eggs for something else from the same box. How many eggs does the baker use in all?
Each pizza has 7 slices. There are 3 pizzas. The family eats 8 slices. How many slices are left?
Max buys 4 books for $4 each and 4 pens for $9 each. How many dollars does Max spend in all?
Zoe practises piano for 4 hours and then for 26 more minutes. How many minutes did Zoe practise in all?
A theatre has 9 rows with 9 seats in each row. 47 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
A teacher has 5 packs with 6 crayons in each pack. She shares all the crayons equally among 2 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
Layla gets $3 pocket money every day for 4 days. Layla spends $7 on a toy. How many dollars does Layla have left?
A cyclist rides 38 kilometres each day for 2 days. After 30 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to ride?
A garden is 8 metres long and 6 metres wide. How many metres of fence are needed to go all the way around it?
A shop buys toy cars for $8 each and sells them for $11 each. How many dollars of profit does the shop make on 6 toy cars?
A teacher buys 3 packs with 10 pencils in each pack. She shares all the pencils equally among 6 classes. How many pencils does each class get?
Zoe watches a film for 47 minutes. Then Zoe takes a 17-minute break and watches the film for 30 more minutes. How many minutes does Zoe spend watching the film in all?
A rug is 3 metres long and 3 metres wide. How many square metres is the rug?
A table is 10 metres long and 8 metres wide. How many metres of ribbon are needed to go all the way around the table?
Omar buys 3 rulers for $10 each and 2 erasers for $4 each. Omar pays with $40. How many dollars of change does Omar get?
A runner runs 18 kilometres each day for 3 days. After running 21 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to run?
A child buys cups of lemonade for $3 each and sells them for $6 each. How much profit does the child make on 8 cups?
A baker makes 5 trays with 9 scones on each tray. She shares all the scones equally among 5 friends. How many scones does each friend get?
Mason practises violin for 3 hours and 37 minutes on Saturday and for 1 hour and 11 minutes on Sunday. How many minutes did Mason practise in all?
Mia earns $6 each week for 3 weeks and then spends $12 on a board game. How many dollars does Mia have left?
